'''Even Piell's cruiser''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]].

==History==
This [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] fell under attack from Separatist forces sometime around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while returning from a mission in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] with valuable information concerning the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]] stored in its onboard computers. Commanding the cruiser were Jedi Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] and Captain [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and, when their ship was boarded, they were taken prisoner along with the ship's deck officers and sent to the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] to be tortured for information. The cruiser came under heavy fire during the confrontation.
